items.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
items.summary: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

items.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
items.summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

items.title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
items.summary: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.

items.title: Anchorage, Kalshi Prime let institutions use custodied bitcoin as margin
items.summary: Anchorage clients can pledge bitcoin and stablecoins held at its federally chartered bank as margin on Kalshi Prime's CFTC-regulated venue.

items.title: CFTC backs blockchain-based derivatives infrastructure as Backpack, tZERO win approvals
items.summary: The CFTC has approved the first set of applications to establish regulated derivatives and exchange clearing operations that use blockchain.
